completion_promises.evidence: Added record: ^5.1.2, just_audio: ^0.9.42, web_socket_channel: ^3.0.1 to app/pubspec.yaml dependencies section with inline scope documentation explaining each package's purpose. Dependencies resolved successfully via 'flutter pub get'. Test verifies all three packages are present in pubspec.yaml dependencies map.

Added <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/> and <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO"/> to app/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, before the <application> tag. completion_promises.criterion_text: iOS `Info.plist` gains `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` with a user-facing string.
completion_promises.evidence: Added NSMicrophoneUsageDescription key to app/ios/Runner/Info.plist with user-facing value: 'Study Tutor uses your microphone for voice interactions with your AI tutor. You can ask questions and receive spoken responses.' This description is required by Apple for App Store submission and will be shown to users when the app requests microphone permission. Test verifies the key is present and has a non-empty, user-facing string value (length > 20 characters).

completion_promises.criterion_text: NSC extension added as documented posture hygiene only; `usesCleartextTraffic` is **not** used
completion_promises.evidence: Created app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml with restrictive base-config (cleartextTrafficPermitted="false", HTTPS-only, system CA trust anchors). Added android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config" reference to main manifest's <application> tag. This NSC is documented as posture hygiene that future-proofs native-stack traffic (e.g., WebSocket plugins). Critically, usesCleartextTraffic (broad unrestricted permission) is NOT used - instead, we have a properly scoped NSC with explicit deny-by-default posture. Debug flavour retains its own scoped NSC allowing cleartext only to 10.0.2.2 (emulator host alias for GB10 dev adapter). Tests verify: (1) networkSecurityConfig reference in manifest, (2) main NSC file exists, (3) cleartextTrafficPermitted="false" present, (4) usesCleartextTraffic NOT present.
